templates.title: Public Conversation
templates.subject: We need a public conversation about Flock
templates.message:
Hello,

I am a resident of Mesa County and I am concerned about mass surveillance in my community. The proliferation of Flock and other ALPR cameras in the past few years has happened with no public communication or oversight. This is unacceptable for a surveillance system that has serious privacy concerns, has had many documented cases of abuse, and has no substantial evidence that it meaningfully prevents crime.

I am calling for city council to have a public conversation on this issue. I have many unanswered questions about ALPRs, and this issue deserved to be put on the agenda.

templates.title: Public Conversation 2
templates.subject: Put Flock on the Agenda
templates.message:
To City Council,

I am requesting that you schedule a public meeting to take place on Flock cameras and mass surveillance more generally. Recently a federal judge has ruled this system unconstitutional as it violates our 4th amendment rights. Please set a date for this discussion; I know many other concerned citizens of the county who agree with me on this issue.

Regards,
